shared_elements: low-relief carving covering the face of an upright stone slab/pillar
curvilinear, interlacing or serpentine linear motifs
motifs arranged over broad flat panels of the monolith
justification: Both surfaces show shallow relief on a large upright stone face with schematic, curvilinear creature-like motifs, which is about as generic a correspondence as carved monoliths can offer. A presents a few isolated, widely spaced motifs (a net/serpentine pattern on one face, a single profile animal on another) on plain undecorated ground, whereas B is a dense, horror-vacui field of interlocking sign-blocks and scrollwork with no empty ground; the compositional logic and motif vocabulary are quite different.
